visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a beige tank top and white skirt, sits comfortably in a grey armchair in a brightly lit room. She holds a white ceramic cup with both hands, looking towards a window with horizontal blinds. A split-screen at the top shows a macro close-up of skin texture before and after treatment. (2) A close-up shot focuses on a grey wall featuring a logo for 'HEALTHY AESTHETIC CLINIC' in metallic lettering. Next to it, a green plant leaf is visible. The scene cuts to a mobile medical machine with a screen and various attachments, labeled 'Cure Jet'. (3) The woman is now in a consultation room with a male doctor. The doctor wears a white coat and a surgical mask, pointing at the woman's cheek as she looks into a round mirror. The background shows a modern office setting with wooden panels. (4) In a treatment room, the woman lies on a white bed. A staff member wearing blue gloves applies a layer of white facial cream using a spatula. The lighting is soft and even. (5) An extreme close-up shows the 'Cure Jet' handpiece hovering over the woman's skin, emitting tiny droplets of liquid. The skin surface is glistening with moisture. The woman's eyes are closed and she appears relaxed. (6) A close-up of a digital display screen on the medical device shows numerical values for 'Power' and 'Volume' with blue graphical indicators. (7) A series of close-ups show the woman's face post-treatment, highlighting smooth and radiant skin. A final shot shows her sitting in the armchair again, smiling and gesturing towards the camera. Yellow text captions appear at the bottom throughout.
